reviewed_overlaps.disposition: Shared provider prefix is resolved by the next reserved token: 'implementation' cannot be an identifier, so provider implementation and ordinary provider contract forms cannot both succeed on the same token stream.

After 'boundary', reserved 'representation' commits the boundary-representation requirement; the ordinary boundary requirement requires an identifier followed by ':'. Lexical keyword priority prevents reinterpretation.
A maximal qualified name followed by '{' commits record_pattern; otherwise only a single identifier may close as the ordinary identifier pattern.
Parenthesized and tuple expressions share '('. After the first expression, comma commits a tuple while ')' commits grouping; a tuple requires at least two elements.

A name-shaped additive expression is a relation only when an explicit relation operator follows its complete left operand; otherwise the claim-application form is selected by its required argument list.
A following relation operator after the balanced left additive operand commits relation_proposition; otherwise balanced parenthesized proposition syntax closes the atom.
Bare 'false' is the literal proposition only when no relation operator follows; with a relation operator it is the complete left additive operand of relation_proposition.
Bare 'true' is the literal proposition only when no relation operator follows; with a relation operator it is the complete left additive operand of relation_proposition.
A parenthesized static value closes at ')' after one static expression; a tuple type is committed by the comma following its first type element.
Brace-led refinement types require ':' after their initial identifier, while effect-set literals use effect expressions; the first required structural separator commits the category.
